title: Color Picker
description: One colour out of a few, as a row of swatches: ColorPicker (bits-ui RadioGroup; bind:value is the picked swatch's value as written, name and required for forms, disabled) and ColorPickerSwatch (a 32px disc of any CSS colour with a hairline, drawn in with a primary ring when picked, 44px to touch, aria-label required). Tab enters at the picked one, the arrows move and pick. No copy inside: you name every colour.
